name: self-engine-sample
description: Three microservices (orders → billing → notifications) running entirely on the LSS self engine: DynamoDB, SQS, S3 and EventBridge emulated in-process — no Docker, no LocalStack, no auth token.

scripts.register:all: npm run register:orders && npm run register:billing && npm run register:notifications
scripts.setup: npm --prefix orders-service install && npm --prefix billing-service install && npm --prefix notifications-service install
